{{Top|leg}}
A '''runcart''' was a form of wheeled transport that ran on rails. Several [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] dens, including one on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], had this system implemented in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] area to help move loads.
